vshadowmount 20240229

Use vshadowmount to mount a Volume Service Snapshot (VSS) volume

Usage: vshadowmount [ -o offset ] [ -X extended_options ] [ -hvV ] volume
                    mount_point

	volume:      a Volume Service Snapshot (VSS) volume

	mount_point: the directory to serve as mount point

	-h:          shows this help
	-o:          specify the volume offset in bytes
	-v:          verbose output to stderr, while vshadowmount will remain running in
	             the foreground
	-V:          print version
	-X:          extended options to pass to sub system

# --- stderr ---
